title: Promotional Uplift and Circle Bonus Figures by Northbeam Renew Trade-In Programme
content:
Northbeam Renew Trade-In carries two kinds of uplift figure per programme: the uplift paid on the appraised amount during a named promotion, with the most that uplift may add on one device, and whether the Circle tier's trade-in bonus is added on that programme at all.

| Renew programme | Promotional uplift, per cent | Most the promotional uplift may add on one device, USD | Circle trade-in bonus added |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Renew Instant Store Quote | 0 | 0.00 | yes |
| Renew Mail In Appraisal | 10 | 100.00 | yes |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month | 15 | 200.00 | yes |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month | 15 | 250.00 | yes |
| Renew Business Asset Buyback | 5 | 150.00 | no |
| Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement | 8 | 200.00 | no |

Basis questions the schedule answers.

*What does a promotional uplift figure of 0 per cent on Renew Instant Store Quote mean?* That programme carries no promotional uplift percentage and no cap for one, both columns standing at 0.

*Is the Circle bonus column the same thing as the promotional uplift column?* No. The promotional uplift columns are the percentage and cap this Renew programme carries for a named promotion. The Circle bonus column says only whether this programme takes the Circle tier's trade-in bonus at all; the two business programmes do not.

*Do the two trade-up programmes carry the same figures?* They carry the same uplift percentage of 15 per cent, but not the same cap: 200.00 USD on Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month and 250.00 USD on Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month.
